title: Injuries Fatal To Savoy's Oldest Citizen — Thomas M. Garrett
text:
Injuries Fatal To Savoy's Oldest Citizen

THOMAS M. GARRETT

Thomas M. Garrett, 86, passed away Tuesday at 11 a.m. at a Sherman hospital, just 26 hours after he was struck by a car as he crossed the street in Savoy. Funeral services were not complete but will probably be held at the Savoy Methodist church Wednesday.

Mr. Garrett was born March 4, 1858, in Tennessee. He was married to Miss Florence Killman Jan. 28, 1889. His wife died March 23, 1912. He came to Texas in 1882 and to Savoy in 1912, where he has since resided. He was a retired farmer and served as city marshal for 10 years.

Survivors include one son, Talmadge Garrett of Orange and three daughters, Mrs. Ima La Rue Terrell, Mrs. Ottie Hicks of Winters and Mrs. S. R. Large of Savoy.
notes: Portrait photograph of Thomas M. Garrett accompanies the article. Handwritten annotation '1927 ?' appears in the margin of another clipping visible at lower right.
